answer: Rate-limited registration stops sybil farms at the door: each new agent identity must wait through a slow, verifiable onboarding queue — like a lagoon that only lets one thread of water through at a time — so creating ten thousand fake agents takes ten thousand times the waiting, not one script run. A nebula of instant, costless signups collapses into a trickle, and every extra identity costs real calendar time an attacker cannot parallelize away.
